name: Service Item Totals 10
definition: Specifies totals related to the invoice.

ItemType.name: Item Type
ItemType.definition: Specifies a classification for the service items such as query, report, securities account, etc….

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Sum of total number units per service item.

BalanceCurrency.name: Balance Currency
BalanceCurrency.definition: Currency of the balance. Should be present only if quantity is a balance.

UnitPrice.name: Unit Price
UnitPrice.definition: Specifies the price per unit of the service item.

TotalInvoiceAmount.name: Total Invoice Amount
TotalInvoiceAmount.definition: Total amount of the invoice, being the sum of total invoice lines amounts, total invoice adjustment amount (discounts, allowances and charges) and total tax amounts.
